preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 500.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a[i][j] <= 1023 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All elements in the matrix must be non-negative integers not exceeding 1023.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NIE' if all(a[i][j] == 0 for i in range(n) for j in range(m)) else True
postconditions.description: If all elements in the matrix are zero, output 'NIE'.
If a valid selection exists, output 'TAK' followed by n integers.
The selected integers must ensure the bitwise XOR is strictly greater than zero.
